# === wfs.md ===

--8<-- [start:wfs_example]
-table(wins/1)

move('a', 'b'),
move('b', 'c'),
move('c', 'a'),

wins(X) <- (move(X, Y), (not wins(Y)))
--8<-- [end:wfs_example]

--8<-- [start:wfs_directive]
-table(pred/arity)
--8<-- [end:wfs_directive]

# === architecture.md ===

--8<-- [start:architecture_diagram]
clausal                      import hook, reader, seam (--/++), public API
├── import_hook.py           .clausal/.seam/.pl loading, .pyc caching
├── templating/              term rewriting (source -> clause terms)
├── pythonic_ast/            the goal/term node types
└── testing.py               pytest integration (test/1 collector)
clausal.logic                core logic engine
├── compiler_v2.py           module pipeline (imports, directives, expansion, compile)
├── compiler/                clause -> Python generator codegen, indexing
├── database.py              predicate rows: clauses, dispatch, tables
├── variables/               logic variables + trail (C extension)
├── trampoline.py            constant-stack driver (C twin + _trampoline_py.py)
├── seam.py / solve.py       goal-position seam; solve/call/once/query_wfs
├── builtins/                built-in predicates (lists, arithmetic, io, ...)
├── clpfd.py, clpq/, clpr.py, clpb.py    constraint solvers
└── tabling.py               SLG resolution + well-founded semantics
clausal.modules.py           library wrappers (re, logging, datetime, sqlite, ...)
packages/clausal-trealla     embedded Trealla Prolog engine (optional)
packages/clausal-scryer      embedded Scryer Prolog engine (optional)
--8<-- [end:architecture_diagram]

# === caching.md ===

--8<-- [start:caching_phases]
exec() phase:     assert clause 1, assert clause 2, ..., assert clause N
compile phase:    compile_predicate(all N clauses)  <- once
--8<-- [end:caching_phases]

# === compiler.md ===

--8<-- [start:compiler_phases]
Phase A: Source -> EmbedTransformer -> module_items + Python AST bytecode
Phase B: compile_module(predicate_nodes, module_items, module_dict) -> compiled predicates
--8<-- [end:compiler_phases]

# === python_integration.md ===

--8<-- [start:python_escape_example]
item(1), item(2), item(3),
doubled(R) <- (item(X), R is ++(X * 2))
test("doubled") <- doubled(4)
--8<-- [end:python_escape_example]
